reconciliation_method.rule_1: Use current repository contracts as exact source for the 30 implemented v1 targets.
reconciliation_method.rule_2: Use preserved transcript/current P0 artifacts as exact source when a canonical target string is literally present.
reconciliation_method.rule_3: When source semantics/count are explicit but a historical canonical string is absent, establish a prospective canonical ID in P0-16; do not claim it reproduces a hidden historical ID.
reconciliation_method.rule_4: No target may remain labeled RECONSTRUCTED in the frozen registry. Every target is either exact-from-source or explicitly canonicalized by P0-16.

migration_invariants: Schema 1.0.0 snapshots remain immutable and valid historical artifacts.
No new v1.1 field is populated merely because source knowledge exists.
No lower-precedence knowledge overwrites explicit/confirmed/locked user state.
Reference Binding does not mutate Product State by itself.
Visualization Verification does not become Product State.
Presentation parameters remain outside Product State.
Quantitative values are not invented from qualitative language or unscaled imagery.
